title: Choose with if and else
instructions_md:
## Two paths

`if` runs its block only when the condition is `True`. `else` runs when it is not. A **block** is the lines moved in by four spaces. End the `if` and `else` lines with `:`.

```python
battery = 15
if battery < 20:
    print("Charge now.")
else:
    print("Battery is fine.")
```

```text
Charge now.
```

## Your task

Ask `Score: `. If the score is `50` or more, print `Pass`. If not, print `Try again`.
hints: Turn the answer into a number first.
Read the score with `int(input(...))`, then print inside each of the two blocks.
